name: Insectomania
source:
Insects, bio machines and a spy? What is happening!?

You are plunged into a world that is about to be changed by the experiments of a maniacal man! It is your mission to uncover his secrets and foil his plans.

[From [url=https://studio-lemi.itch.io/insectomania]Itch.io[/url]]
